seo.description: Building the Digital Foundation for a Global Language & BPO Provider. The challenge, our approach, and the results for Kalam.

title: Building the Digital Foundation for a Global Language & BPO Provider
summary: Kalam CX is a global language solutions and business process outsourcing company serving clients across 55+ countries in more than 200 languages.

challenge.title: Kalam CX needed a stronger digital ecosystem to support its global BPO and language operations.
items: Marketing, recruitment, and support workflows were spread across multiple systems.
The website had to support both client acquisition and interpreter recruitment.
Leadership needed clearer visibility across campaigns, tickets, and performance.
Internal teams required smoother automation between departments.
The digital presence needed to reflect Kalam's global scale and 200+ language capability.

approach.title: Unified the Digital Presence
approach.summary: We aligned Kalam's brand, website, and digital ecosystem into one consistent customer experience.

approach.title: Improved Customer & Candidate Journeys
approach.summary: We redesigned the website around the needs of both clients and interpreters.

approach.title: Connected Marketing Operations
approach.summary: We supported workflows and automation that simplified marketing, recruitment, and customer operations.
